visual_findings: The opaque-card defect is fixed, but the replacement still reads as thin orange line geometry, long hairline rays, and partial circular arc fragments rather than authored fire volumes.
Muzzle ignition has a usable dense core, yet peak collapses into a line star and near-peak becomes an even sparser crossing-line bundle. It does not sustain a coherent asymmetric ignition plume.

Attached Flight is a very small orange dot/pill with two or three straight bars. It is nearly invisible in hero and gameplay, has no continuous body-contact flame tongue, and does not communicate Incinerator heat or speed.
Impact contact and peak are primarily radial needle stars. Decay is four soft circular dots with no soot, pressure mass, surface contact, or coherent fire residue.

The body is more readable than R1 but still renders as broad smooth blue-gray fields with flat orange rectangles. The approved Blender metal, heat, recess, brace and depth hierarchy is not restored strongly enough in Unity or in the fixed rig.

The comparison remains below Gunner_Bullet and Fighter_Attack in mass, softness, layering, motion readability, and polish, and below the user's supplied Flamethrower/MagmaCrusher school reference floor.

r3_authorization.body_requirement: Recalibrate the eight URP/Lit roles and fixed rig against approved Blender R11 originals: distinct dark forged steel, gunmetal braces, heat-darkened interfaces and restrained hot panels, with readable midtones and bevel/specular depth. Do not solve with new floating decorative geometry.
r3_authorization.muzzle_requirement: Use a compact asymmetric 3-5 lobe soft flame discharge with a white-yellow pressure core, orange-red outer tongues, one or two short tapered ember streak groups and a restrained broken heat envelope. Remove line-star rays and circular arc fragments.
r3_authorization.flight_requirement: Use a continuous rear-contact flame tongue approximately 0.7-1.2 body lengths, layered inner yellow core plus orange/red soft lobes and a faint soot edge, with sparse unequal embers. It must remain visible in hero, gameplay and rear views without becoming an opaque card or pill.
r3_authorization.impact_requirement: Use a broad asymmetric 3-5 lobe fireball/contact burst with a hot core, short tapered fragments, soft smoke/soot and readable ember decay. Remove radial needle-star construction and isolated circular decay dots.
forbidden_visual_language: full or partial ring as dominant shape
required_evidence: F hero macro gameplay rear wake
approved Blender R11 versus Unity body material comparison

root_note: R2 fixes transparency but not the visual grammar. R3 must read as soft layered combustion with a continuous flight flame and broad fire impact; thin lines, arcs and dots are not acceptable substitutes for fire.
